scope: 15 selected examples, not a benchmark; training/test independence unknown
inference: Original source resolution, no input resize; evaluation mode. Actual device is recorded per method and run.
icig_input: Original supplied VIS_Y for ICIG; RGB for color reconstruction
letters_input: RGB visible, grayscale IR; all pixels valid, material from visible color
prcv_input: RGB visible and original grayscale IR; supplied PRCV inference adapter
metrics: Saved gray output: ICIG raw fused gray; letters and PRCV Pillow L of final color
timing: Separate earlier four-method and incremental PRCV runs; not a contemporaneous speed benchmark.
display: Precomputed color previews with display scaling and center crops; not browser neural inference. Metrics use full-resolution gray outputs.
